en.headline: Air Niugini flight from Hong Kong lands safely in Philippines after engine fire alert
en.dek: All 146 passengers and crew evacuated uninjured after the Boeing 767 diverted to Davao early Saturday following a right-engine fire indication.
body: An Air Niugini flight from Hong Kong to Port Moresby made an emergency landing at Davao International Airport in the southern Philippines early on Saturday after pilots received a fire indication for the right engine.

The Boeing 767-300 operating as PX19 was carrying 137 passengers and nine crew members. Philippine aviation authorities said the aircraft landed safely at about 12.08am local time and that all 146 people on board were uninjured. Passengers left the aircraft using emergency slides.

Air Niugini said the crew followed standard procedures, shut down and secured the affected engine, and diverted. The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines confirmed no injuries and dispatched an investigator. The airline said it was arranging accommodation and onward travel for passengers.
Airport operations at Davao were temporarily suspended for the emergency response, with two inbound domestic flights cancelled. The aircraft remained on the ground while checks continued.

zh.headline: 香港起飛新幾內亞航空客機引擎火警 菲律賓達沃安全降落
zh.dek: 波音767客機載有146人，因右引擎火警指示緊急降落達沃，全員經逃生滑梯撤離，無人受傷。
body: 一班由香港起飛前往巴布亞新幾內亞莫爾茲比港的新幾內亞航空航班，因右引擎出現火警指示，於周六凌晨在菲律賓南部達沃國際機場緊急降落。
該波音767-300客機（航班PX19）載有137名乘客及9名機組人員。菲律賓民航當局表示，飛機於當地時間約凌晨12時08分安全着陸，機上146人全部無恙，乘客經逃生滑梯撤離。
新幾內亞航空表示，機組人員按標準程序關閉並固定受影響引擎後改道。菲律賓民航局確認無人受傷，並已派出調查人員。航空公司正安排乘客住宿及後續行程。
達沃機場因緊急應對暫時關閉，兩班國內入境航班取消。飛機仍留在地面接受檢查。
